G2747.name: Cenchreae
G2747.brief: Port of Corinth; home of Phoebe
G2747.short: Cenchreae was the eastern port of Corinth, where Paul had his hair cut in connection with a vow, and was the home of Phoebe, a deaconess of the church.

G2791.name: Cilicia
G2791.brief: Province in Asia Minor; Paul's birthplace and ministry area
G2791.short: Cilicia, a province in southeast Asia Minor, was the birthplace of Paul and an area where he ministered to the early churches.
